candidates.description: These tokens represent various terms, kanji, and concepts related to traditional Japanese martial arts, particularly Karate.
This feature vector represents morphological variations and translations of the root word related to perception, meaning, or thought ("sense" in English and its equivalents in Romance languages).
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens starting with the letter sequence 'K'.
This vector represents the concept of variety, difference, and distinction.
This feature vector represents words indicating relative order, rank, or recurrence such as numerical sequence and uniqueness.
These tokens represent common English verbs ending in standard derivational suffixes indicating action or state.
This vector represents concepts related to events, outcomes, consequences, and occurrences.
This vector represents the phoneme "ang" or strings ending in the "ang" sound across various languages and scripts.
This vector represents adverbial suffixes and adverbs, particularly those forming adverbs of manner in Romance languages like Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the vowel 'u' preceded by various consonants.
